SHOKZ

Why consider Shokz for running?

Start with the design you want: an open ear canal, a connected frame and a choice of neckband sizes. Other brands also offer open-ear designs; this table compares specific models rather than entire brands.

How to read this comparison

Shokz / soundcore: IP55; Suunto: IP66; Bose: IPX4. Bose still resists splashes; it does not meet this column’s dust and water-jet criteria. Suunto’s external power accessory is different from an earbud charging case. AeroFit 2 offers four adjustable ear-hook positions instead of neckband sizes.

Claimed single-charge playback: 12 / 12 / 10 / 9 hours respectively. Conditions differ. Hybrid drivers are a configuration, not proof of better sound. German availability of competitor variants has not been verified; follow the official sources before buying.

If you want an open ear canal, prefer a connected wraparound frame and need Standard / Mini options, OpenRun Pro 2 is worth considering. Its bone-and-air design aims to improve open-ear listening; the sound and fit still need to suit you.

Open ears, fewer in-ear compromises

An open ear canal allows surrounding sound to enter. It does not guarantee hearing every bell or vehicle, and is not proof of hearing protection. All five share this benefit; it does not distinguish their rankings.

A transparent recommendation, not a test verdict

Overall score = Σ(feature score × priority) ÷ Σ(priorities). Equal starting weights; scores shown to one decimal. Models within 0.2 points of the leader are close matches. Rankings use unrounded values.

Size and pure-bone preferences filter recommendations. The open-ear score is shared by every model, so a high weight there compresses differences without changing their order. Audio configuration scores are editorial choices; no claim is made about measured sound quality.

Missing active data excludes a model from complete ranking. Zero-weight dimensions do not require complete data. Price is an affordability scale, not an absolute budget filter. Charging and weight scales are explained in their sections.

Quick answers

Is Mini less capable?

It is a shorter neckband, not a lower feature tier. Check fit separately.

Does Pro mean better in every way?

No. Compare the protection rating, charger, weight and price alongside audio configuration and battery.

Is Pro 2 purely bone conduction?

No. DualPitch combines bone and air conduction.

Can I swim in these?

No. These five running models are not the swimming series, even where IP67 is stated.
